policy: Discovery only. Files are not copied. Repository presence and public paths do not establish permission. Empathy Ledger authority records govern reuse.

projects.name: A Curious Tractor
projects.invitation: Begin with the art. Follow the object, image or question into the wider field.
projects.storyThread: Two people learning what to build, what to hold and what to give away.
projects.motionIdea: A quiet aerial field gives way to objects, hands and unfinished work.

projects.name: Empathy Ledger
projects.invitation: Hear a voice. See how permission travels with it.
projects.storyThread: The story remains with the storyteller after the camera leaves.
projects.motionIdea: Voice, breath and transcript move together. Consent remains visible at the edge.

projects.name: JusticeHub
projects.invitation: Enter through CONTAINED. Leave through a community alternative.
projects.storyThread: The cell is expensive. The fire already holds another answer.
projects.motionIdea: A container opens into roads, programs, people and proof.

projects.name: Goods on Country
projects.invitation: Touch the object. Follow its materials, repair and value home.
projects.storyThread: A bed arrives. The harder question is what stays after the truck leaves.
projects.motionIdea: Assembly, testing and distance become a moving material story.

candidates.path: v2/docs/Final Snow pitch with Snow feedback and reflections.md

projects.name: The Harvest
projects.invitation: Come to the table. Find the garden, kitchen and people holding it open.
projects.storyThread: A kettle, a plate and a garden lower the distance between strangers.
projects.motionIdea: Hands move from soil to table while the day changes around the place.

projects.name: Black Cockatoo Valley
projects.invitation: Walk into the valley. Let place slow the rest of the website down.
projects.storyThread: Place is one of the ways the work thinks.
projects.motionIdea: Mist, creek, fence, bird and boots. No rush to explain.

projects.name: Art + CONTAINED
projects.invitation: Cross the threshold. Feel the system before reading about it.
projects.storyThread: Art keeps the contradiction in the room.
projects.motionIdea: Darkness, steel, light and voice turn a page into an encounter.

projects.name: Oonchiumpa
projects.invitation: A governed source. Nothing travels without community authority.
projects.storyThread: The kitchen table holds the decision before the platform does.
projects.motionIdea: Interaction pattern reference only until a media packet is approved.

projects.name: Palm Island Repository
projects.invitation: A community archive, not an ACT media library.
projects.storyThread: The story returns to the island and remains governed there.
projects.motionIdea: Study the archive pattern. Do not lift the archive material.

projects.name: ACT video storytelling
projects.invitation: Test how voice can move without becoming spectacle.
projects.storyThread: The edit follows breath before it follows brand.
projects.motionIdea: Voice Canvas, emotional arcs and photo reveals form the motion grammar.

projects.name: Living story map
projects.invitation: A governed Oonchiumpa and Palm story system.
projects.storyThread: People move across time. Aspirations become milestones.
projects.motionIdea: Use the horizontal-time and vertical-people pattern, not its community media.

projects.name: Reciprocal Voices
projects.invitation: Pick up the handset. A voice changes the space around it.
projects.storyThread: Listening is an action the visitor performs.
projects.motionIdea: Voice particles gather and separate around a physical gesture.
